newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VNU SAYS FULL-YEAR PROFIT GROWTH WILL MATCH H1.
newsitem.headline: VNU SAYS FULL-YEAR PROFIT GROWTH WILL MATCH H1.

text.p: Publisher Verenigd Bezit VNU said on Tuesday it expected growth of profits and earnings per share for the whole of 1996 at least to match the growth rates achieved in the first half of this year.
"In the second half of 1966, results will continue to develop favourably. However, we anticipate that market conditions in commercial broadcasting will not improve markedly," VNU said.
"Accordingly, we expect growth in net earnings and earnings per share for the full year 1996 to be at least at the same level as in the first half," the company said in a statement.
In the first half of 1996 VNU's net profit from ordinary operations rose 13 percent to 143 million guilders. Earnings per share also rose by 13 percent to 0.75 guilders.
All of VNU's businesses posted higher operating profits except commercial television which slipped to a loss of six million guilders from a profit of 33 million.
